'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 Delhi car explosion]]
**Thirteen people are killed and over 20 others are injured in a suspected [[car bomb]]ing near the [[Red Fort]] in [[New Delhi]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/11/delhi-red-fort-blast-kills-13-what-happened-as-police-invoke-terror-law (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**The [[Colombia]]n [[Military Forces of Colombia|military]] conducts airstrikes in the [[Amazon natural region|Amazon region]] following failed [[Colombian peace process|peace talks]], killing 19 [[FARC]] [[splinter group]] fighters. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/colombia-military-says-airstrikes-kill-19-guerrillas/ (AFP via CTV News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[Cadet College Wana attack]]
***At least three people are killed during an attack by the [[Pakistani Taliban]] on a [[cadet college]] in [[South Waziristan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/suicide-bombers-who-attacked-pakistan-were-afghan-nationals-pakistan-interior-2025-11-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2025 Booker Prize]]
**[[British literature|British]]–[[Hungarian literature|Hungarian]] writer [[David Szalay]] wins the 2025 [[Booker Prize]] for his novel ''[[Flesh (Szalay novel)|Flesh]]''. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/life/arts-and-entertainment/3135006/szalay-wins-booker-prize-for-tortured-tale-of-masculinity (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*A [[Judiciary of Brazil|court]] declares [[Brazil]]ian [[Telecommunications in Brazil|telecommunications]] company [[Oi (telecommunications)|Oi]] bankrupt, the largest [[bankruptcy]] in the country's history. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Two people are killed when a [[Beechcraft King Air]] plane carrying [[Hurricane Melissa]] relief supplies for [[Jamaica]] crashes into a pond in [[Coral Springs, Florida|Coral Springs]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/11/10/us/small-plane-crash-coral-springs-fl (CNN)] [https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/news/2025/11/10/coral-springs-plane-crash-florida-beechcraft-jamaica-hurricane-relief/87200612007/ (''The Palm Beach Post'')]
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll from [[Typhoon Fung-wong (2025)|Typhoon Fung-wong]]'s impact on [[Luzon]], [[Philippines]], rises to 25, with more than 1.4 million others displaced. [https://apnews.com/article/typhoon-fungwong-philippines-taiwan-9e1e11220779b25af27b7c8e2d24a3d5 (AP)]
*The death toll from a [[Rohingya]] boat sinking near [[Langkawi]], [[Malaysia]], rises to 21 as authorities in Malaysia and [[Thailand]] continue their [[search and rescue]] operations, with 13 survivors having been rescued and detained for [[Immigration to Malaysia|immigration]] investigations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/migrant-boat-that-sank-off-thai-malaysia-border-was-carrying-around-70-people-2025-11-10/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are killed, including three officials from the national registry, when a passenger [[Cessna 206]] plane crashes in a jungle in [[Colombia]]. [https://tn.com.ar/internacional/2025/11/11/tragedia-aerea-en-colombia-se-estrello-una-avioneta-en-la-selva-y-murieron-tres-funcionarios-y-el-piloto/ (Todo Noticias <small>in Spanish</small>)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2025 United Nations Climate Change Conference]]
**In [[Belém, Pará]], [[Brazil]], the 30th [[United Nations Climate Change Conference]] begins. [https://g1.globo.com/meio-ambiente/cop-30/noticia/2025/11/10/cop30-comeca-oficialmente-nesta-segunda-saiba-o-que-esta-em-jogo-e-o-que-esperar-da-conferencia-sobre-a-crise-do-clima.ghtml (G1)] [https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/nacional/brasil/cop30-tudo-que-voce-precisa-saber-sobre-o-evento/ (CNN Brasil)]
*The [[Pan American Health Organization]] rescinds [[Canada]]'s [[measles]] elimination status after more than a year of continuous transmission and over 5,000 confirmed cases across most [[Provinces and territories of Canada|provinces]], declaring that the [[Americas]] region as a whole no longer meets elimination criteria. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/canada-has-lost-its-measles-elimination-status-says-ottawa-2025-11-10/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Cambodia–Thailand relations]]
**[[2025 Cambodian–Thai border crisis]]
***[[Thailand]] suspends the implementation of a [[Kuala Lumpur Peace Accord|peace agreement]] with [[Cambodia]] after a [[Land mines in Cambodia|land mine]] explosion injures two [[Royal Thai Army|Thai soldiers]] in [[Sisaket province]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/thailand-cambodia-halts-peace-deal-landmine-injures-5457566 (AFP via CNA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election]], [[Trump fake electors plot]]
***[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] grants [[Federal pardons in the United States|pardons]] to 77 people, including [[Republican Party (United States)|political allies]] who are accused of [[electoral fraud in the United States|electoral fraud]]-related charges from the [[Republican reactions to Donald Trump's claims of 2020 election fraud|2020 presidential election]], including several who have pled guilty. [https://www.npr.org/2025/11/10/nx-s1-5604174/trump-pardons-2020-election (NPR)]
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**Former [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]], former [[Ministry of National Defense (South Korea)|defense minister]] [[Kim Yong-hyun (general)|Kim Yong-hyun]], and former [[Defense Counterintelligence Command]] leader [[Yeo In-hyung]] are indicted on additional charges related to Yoon's attempt to invoke [[martial law]] last December alleging that they ordered [[surveillance aircraft|surveillance drones]] to be sent into [[North Korea]] to stoke [[Korean conflict|tensions]] and justify their plans. [https://www.dw.com/en/south-koreas-ex-president-yoon-indicted-on-new-charges/a-74681478 (DW)] [https://www.chosun.com/english/national-en/2025/11/11/5YLGZFT6HNAIVBIOTUHZQZIAKI/ (''The Chosun Ilbo'')]
*[[Corruption in Nigeria]]
**[[Nigeria]]'s [[Economic and Financial Crimes Commission|anti-graft agency]] issues an [[arrest warrant]] for former [[Federal Ministry of Petroleum Resources|petroleum minister]] [[Timipre Sylva]] on charges of [[criminal conspiracy|conspiracy]] and [[fraud]] of US$14.85 million allocated by the [[Petroleum industry in Nigeria|Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board]] for a [[Oil refinery|refinery]] project. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigeria-graft-agency-says-arrest-warrant-issued-ex-oil-minister-sylva-over-fraud-2025-11-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**[[Ecuador]]ian [[President of Ecuador|president]] [[Daniel Noboa]] transfers 300 high-risk inmates, including former [[Vice President of Ecuador|vice president]] [[Jorge Glas]], to the [[El Encuentro (prison)|El Encuentro]] maximum-security prison in [[Santa Elena Province|Santa Elena]] as part of a security strategy targeting gang activity inside [[Prison overcrowding|overcrowded prisons]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-transfers-300-high-risk-inmates-new-maximum-security-prison-2025-11-10/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Court of appeal (France)|court of appeals]] in [[Paris]], [[France]], releases former [[President of France|president]] [[Nicolas Sarkozy]] from [[La Santé Prison|prison]] under judicial supervision conditions, less than three weeks after he began to serve a five-year sentence for [[criminal conspiracy]] over his [[2007 French presidential election|2007 election campaign]] funds. [https://apnews.com/article/sarkozy-prison-release-france-63fb4cb3e68c6fef393f7f62213d25b7 (AP)]
*[[Lebanon]] grants a [[United States dollar|US$]]900,000 bail to [[Hannibal Gaddafi]], the son of former [[Libya]]n leader [[Muammar Gaddafi]], ending his nearly 10-year detention in a case involving the 1978 disappearance of [[Shia cleric|Shia Muslim cleric]] [[Musa al-Sadr]], for which Gaddafi was accused of [[tampering with evidence|withholding information]] but never tried. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2622130/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*A [[Thailand|Thai]] [[Judiciary of Thailand|court]] orders the [[extradition]] of convicted kingpin [[She Zhijiang]] to [[China]] to face charges related to operating [[cybercrime]] and [[Gambling in Thailand|illegal gambling]] networks across [[Asia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-thailand-extradition-online-gambling-casinos-scams-b04630d73c0b43d95a95f8103305768a (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Egyptian parliamentary election]]
**[[Egyptian nationality law|Egyptians]] begin voting to elect 568 of the 596 members of the [[House of Representatives (Egypt)|House of Representatives]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/many-pro-sisi-parties-little-competition-egypt-votes-new-parliament-2025-11-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 United States federal government shutdown]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 60–40 to a [[Bill (United States Congress)|bill]] to end the 41-day [[Government shutdowns in the United States|government shutdown]] and extend funding for the [[Government of the United States|U.S. government]] until January 30, 2026, sending the bill to the [[United States House of Representatives|House of Representatives]] for a vote. [https://www.npr.org/2025/11/10/g-s1-97245/senate-shutdown-vote (NPR)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-senate-compromise-sets-stage-end-government-shutdown-2025-11-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Indonesia]]n [[President of Indonesia|president]] [[Prabowo Subianto]] posthumously grants the title of [[National Hero of Indonesia|National Hero]] to former president [[Suharto]], despite criticism by activists and civil society due to his [[New Order (Indonesia)|New Order]] [[military dictatorship]]. [https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20251110062531-32-1293704/prabowo-umumkan-10-pahlawan-nasional-termasuk-soeharto-hari-ini (CNN Indonesia)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-set-grant-national-hero-status-late-strongman-president-suharto-2025-11-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Pakistan]]'s [[Senate of Pakistan|Senate]] approves a [[constitutional amendment]] that expands [[Chief of the Army Staff (Pakistan)|Army Chief]] [[Asim Munir]]'s powers by creating the position of Chief of Defence Forces with command over [[Pakistan Armed Forces|all military branches]], while also limiting the [[Supreme Court of Pakistan|Supreme Court]]'s authority. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistans-army-chief-get-expanded-powers-under-proposed-reform-2025-11-10/ (Reuters)]
